content: Womu ɡe Sɑlomɔɔ u kuɑ. Ge wee.

content.text: Gusunɔ, ɑ nɛ sinɑ boko bwisi kɛ̃ɛyɔ
n kɑ siri nɡe mɛ ɑ rɑ siri,
kpɑ n wunɛn tɔmbu siri ɡem sɔɔ
bɑɑ be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑrobu.
Wunɛn ɡem sɔ̃, ben ɡunɡunu kɑ ben ɡuunu nu koo bu ɑrumɑni wɛ̃.
Kon sɑ̃ɑrobu siriɑ kpɑ n bu ben ɡem wɛ̃,
kpɑ n bwɛ̃ɛbwɛ̃ɛbun bibu fɑɑbɑ ko,
n be bɑ bu dɑm dɔremɔ kɔsuku.
Mɛ̀n nɔɔ sɔ̃ɔ kɑ suru yɑrimɔ,
mɛyɑ bɑ ko n mɑɑ nun nɑsie sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔ, ɑ de nɛ, sinɑ boko nɑ n ɑrufɑɑni mɔ
nɡe ɡurɑ ye yɑ nɛmɔ ɡbee te bɑ kɔrɔ kuɑ sɔɔ,
ǹ kun mɛ nɡe nim ɑrufɑɑniɡum mɛ mu kokumɔ ɡberɔ,
kpɑ nɛn bɑndu sɔɔ ɡem mu n wɑ̃ɑ,
kpɑ dukiɑ yu kuurɑ mɛ̀n nɔɔ suru yɑrimɔ.
A de nɑ n bɑndu dii
sɑɑ nim wɔ̃ku ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Mɛditerɑnɛn di
sere n kɑ ɡirɑri nim wɔ̃ku bɔruɡuuɔ,
sɑɑ mɑɑ dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Efɑrɑtin di
sere hɑnduniɑn nɔrɔ.
Kpɑ ɑ mɑɑ de be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡbɑburɔ kpuro
bu nɑ nɛn wuswɑɑɔ bu mɑn yiirɑ,
kpɑ nɛn yibɛrɛbɑ bu tuɑ nɔ.
Tɑɑsisi kɑ tem mɛ mu tomɑn sinɑmbu
bɑ koo kɑ mɑn ɡbere ɡobi nɑɑwɑ.
Sebɑ kɑ Sɑbɑn sinɑmbu bɑ koo kɑ mɑn kɛ̃nu nɑɑwɑ.
Kpɑ sinɑmbu kpuro bu mɑn yiirɑ,
kpɑ bwesenu kpuro nu mɑn sɑ̃.
Domi kon sɑ̃ɑro wi u weeweenu mɔ̀ wɔrɑ,
kpɑ n bwɛ̃ɛbwɛ̃ɛ wi u kun ɡoo mɔ somi.
Mɛyɑ nɑ kon mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑron wɔnwɔndu wɑ,
kpɑ n bwɛ̃ɛbwɛ̃ɛn wɑ̃ɑru wɔrɑ.
Kon bu wɔrɑ be bɑ bu dɑm dɔremɔn min di.
Kon bu yɑkiɑ be bɑ bu nɔni sɔ̃ɔmɔn nɔmɑn di.
Domi ben wɑ̃ɑru tɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ ɡirinu nɛn nɔni sɔɔ.
Kpɑ nɛ sinɑ bokon wɑ̃ɑru tu dɑkɑɑ dɑ,
kpɑ bu kɑ mɑn Sɑbɑn wurɑ nɑɑwɑ.
Bɑ ko n dɑ mɑn kɑnɑru kue tɔ̃ɔ bɑɑtere
bɑ n mɑn domɑru kuɑmmɛ.
Kpɑ ɑlikɑmɑ yu mɑrurɑ tem sɔɔ kɑ ɡuunɔ.
Kpɑ yen winu nu n wom soorɑmɔ nɡe Libɑnin dɑ̃nu.
Mɛyɑ mɑɑ tɔmbɑ koo mɑrurɑ wusu sɔɔ nɡe yɑkɑ bii.
Kpɑ nɛ sinɑ bokon yĩsiru tɑ n yɑrɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ,
bɑ n tu soku mɛ̀n nɔɔ sɔ̃ɔ yɑrimɔ.
Tɔmbu bɑ̀ n ben winsim domɑru kuɑmmɛ,
bɑ n dɑ nɛn yĩsiru soku,
kpɑ bwesenu kpuro nu nɛɛ,
doo nɔɔruɡiiwɑ nɛ sinɑ boko.
Su Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni siɑrɑ.
Domi wi turowɑ u rɑ sɔm mɑɑmɑɑkiɡinu ko.
Su nùn siɑrɑ win yĩsi bɛɛrɛɡii ten sɔ̃.
Win yiiko yu sɔ̃ɔsirɑ hɑnduniɑ kpuro sɔɔ.
Ami! Ami!
Womu ɡeniwɑ Dɑfidi Isɑin bii u kɑ win kɑnɑnu wiru ɡo.
